site.company_name.label: Business name
site.company_name.hint: Shown in the menu when there is no logo, in the footer, in the browser tab and in what Google indexes.

site.company_description.label: One-line description
site.company_description.hint: The sentence under the name in the footer, and what search engines quote. One sentence works best.

site.copyright_text.label: Copyright line
site.copyright_text.hint: After the year and the business name at the very bottom.

site.brand.images.logo.label: Logo
site.brand.images.logo.hint: Top left of every page. Leave it empty and the business name is used as words, which often looks better than a stretched image.

site.brand.images.favicon.label: Browser tab icon
site.brand.images.favicon.hint: The small square in the browser tab and in a bookmark.

site.brand.images.ogImage.label: Social sharing picture
site.brand.images.ogImage.hint: What appears when somebody pastes a link to this site into Slack, LinkedIn or a message. Wide, around 1200 by 630.

site.brand.images.founderPhoto.label: Founder photograph
site.brand.images.founderPhoto.hint: The photograph on the home page and the about page.

site.brand.images.founderPortrait.label: Founder portrait
site.brand.images.founderPortrait.hint: The smaller cut-out used beside the closing call to action.

site.brand.colors.orange.label: Accent colour
site.brand.colors.orange.hint: Used across the whole site. Changing it changes every page at once.

site.brand.colors.deepTeal.label: Deep colour
site.brand.colors.deepTeal.hint: Used across the whole site. Changing it changes every page at once.

site.brand.colors.midTeal.label: Mid colour
site.brand.colors.midTeal.hint: Used across the whole site. Changing it changes every page at once.

site.brand.colors.skyTeal.label: Pale colour
site.brand.colors.skyTeal.hint: Used across the whole site. Changing it changes every page at once.

site.brand.colors.paleTeal.label: Palest colour
site.brand.colors.paleTeal.hint: Used across the whole site. Changing it changes every page at once.

site.show_founder.label: Show the founder
site.show_founder.hint: Off, and no photograph, biography or Person data appears anywhere. A business that does not lead with a person should leave this off.

site.founder_name.label: Founder name
site.founder_name.hint: Used in the alt text of the photograph and in the structured data search engines read.

site.founder_role.label: Founder job title
site.founder_role.hint: For search engines, for example "Agile Coach". Leave empty to claim none.

site.founder_expertise.label: What the founder is known for
site.founder_expertise.hint: One per line, for search engines. These are claims about a named person, so only list what is true.

site.contact_email.label: Email address
site.contact_email.hint: Shown in the footer and on the contact page.

site.contact_phone.label: Telephone
site.contact_phone.hint: Leave empty and no number appears.

site.social_linkedin.label: LinkedIn address
site.social_linkedin.hint: The full web address. Leave empty and the icon does not appear.

site.social_twitter.label: Twitter address
site.social_twitter.hint: The full web address. Leave empty and the icon does not appear.

site.social_facebook.label: Facebook address
site.social_facebook.hint: The full web address. Leave empty and the icon does not appear.

site.social_youtube.label: YouTube address
site.social_youtube.hint: The full web address. Leave empty and the icon does not appear.

site.social_github.label: GitHub address
site.social_github.hint: The full web address. Leave empty and the icon does not appear.
